report_6.original_text:
LUMBOSACRAL SPINE X-RAY
RIGHT HIP X-RAY
Sequelae of total hip prosthesis on the right with no signs of mobilization compared to the previous study of 04/01/2021.
Clinical picture of coxarthrosis on the left with degenerative irregularities and sclerosis of the acetabular roof. Left femoral head normally shaped, in place. No evidence of active bone lesions in the pelvis.
Normal joint and prosthetic relationships.
Spine in axis on the coronal plane with reduction of the physiological curvature on the sagittal plane.
No significant misalignment of the posterior somatic walls.
Morphostructural alteration of the L4 vertebral body with evidence of coarse osteophyte spurs at the vertebral body margins and slight sinking of the lower vertebral body endplate, most likely not recent. No evidence of metameric bone lesions of post-traumatic appearance, particularly of a recent date. Osteophytosis of the somatic margins, icluding at L5-S1 where a clear reduction of the intersomatic space is observed.
Interapophyseal arthrosis phenomena at the lumbosacral passage.
Remaining disc spaces appear normal
Reporting Physician: PERSONS_NAME DR. PERSONS_NAME 
Administered: Codamol:1 tablet
